name: Canon CanoScan LiDE 300 / LiDE 400
summary: Current Canon slim flatbed scanners. On Linux the open-source SANE "pixma" backend drives them, so no Canon software is needed.

linux.notes: Supported by SANE's pixma backend (marked as tested by the SANE project), which comes with the standard SANE packages. Older distributions may ship a SANE version from before these models were added. This recipe has not yet been tested on hardware by Plug Doctor.

darwin.notes: Canon publishes macOS drivers and scanning software for these models on its support site; check that the download lists your macOS version.

win32.notes: Canon publishes Windows drivers and scanning software for these models on its support site.
